title: dob autocomplete tokens
name: Date-of-birth autocomplete tokens
rule: Date of birth fields use autocomplete tokens `bday-day` / `bday-month` / `bday-year`.
pass_when: DOB day/month/year inputs have those autocomplete tokens.
fail_when: DOB segments omit the tokens or use a generic autocomplete.
overview: Date-of-birth segments use bday-day, bday-month, and bday-year autocomplete tokens.
apply_when: Building day, month, and year inputs for date of birth.
not_when: Not for non-DOB dates, or single free-text date fields without segments.
agent_hint: Set autocomplete to bday-day, bday-month, and bday-year on DOB segments.
description: Date-of-birth day, month, and year fields need the matching autocomplete tokens `bday-day`, `bday-month`, and `bday-year` so browsers and password managers can fill them correctly. Those tokens are specific to DOB segments, not a generic autocomplete value. Missing or wrong tokens force retyping and break familiar autofill. Fail if DOB segments omit those tokens or use a generic autocomplete instead. Apply whenever you build segmented day/month/year inputs for date of birth.
do_not_claim: Generic HTML autocomplete+name (`forms.inputs.html_autocomplete_and_name`); typeahead suggestions. Overlap with Forms 54: tokens are the new claim.
